# head.toml

<!-- generated by `letibot --config-reference --markdown head.toml`; do not edit -->

Location: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/letibot/head.toml, else ~/.config/letibot/head.toml

the head's own preferences: flat `key = value` lines, no tables

Written by: the head, from the /config pane and on every saved preference; unknown lines are kept

## `top level`

Booleans take true/false, yes/no or on/off. Shared by every head on the box.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `diff` | "split" \| "unified" | "split" | diff layout: two panels or one |
| `thinking` | "open" \| "folded" | "folded" | thinking blocks start open or folded |
| `tools` | "open" \| "folded" | "folded" | tool calls start open or folded |
| `raw_calls` | bool | false | show the model's raw call markup under each call |
| `todos_hide_done` | bool | true | the todos pane folds the done group |
| `verbosity` | string | "normal" | transcript rung: a profile name, a switch, or `custom ...` |
| `retired` | comma list | "" | note keys this reader retired; written by the head |
| `todo_template` | bool \| path | false | starter todos: true = todo-template.md beside this file, or a path |
| `todo_seed` | comma list | "" | hashed projects already seeded; written by the head |
| `git_format` | string \| false | false | git field template; false = built-in |
| `rooms_sidebar_width` | columns \| false | false | rooms sidebar width; false = configured or default |
| `editor_width` | columns \| false | false | editor column width; false = half the terminal |
| `theme` | string | terminal | themes/NAME.toml beside this file; terminal = terminal palette |
| `color.<role>` | string | theme's | one role's look over the theme, e.g. "bg:#2f363b" |
